title: Gravitational Wave Polarization and Informational Coherence in the Unified Theory of Informational Spin (TGU)
content: Gravitational Wave Polarization and Informational Coherence in the Unified Theory of Informational Spin (TGU) How does informational coherence influence the propagation of gravitational waves? This study, based on data from the LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA O4b observational run, introduces a novel framework through the Unified Theory of Informational Spin (TGU), suggesting that polarization anomalies in gravitational waves may provide a direct signature of structured information in spacetime.Key Findings:
